cpc_range.basis: typical US-role CPC band (planning basis); full observed spread ~$0.10-$5.00+

metadata.model: CPC auction (Sponsored Jobs); PPSA on some setups; PPA discontinued Dec 2023
metadata.notes: Indeed publishes no numeric CPC range (results-based dynamic pricing; confirmed on its own pages). $0.97-$2.71 average-role band per Pin.com citing ThePricer 2026/ShiftNow 2025/Job Board Doctor May 2025 (aggregator-inferred, not Indeed-official). Budget floors are Indeed-official: $5/day min, $25/day per-job floor since Jul 2025, $150/mo min. Cross-check: Appcast 2026 benchmark press coverage confirms CPA/CPH rose in 2025; Recruitonomics sector CPAs $7-16/application at ~5.19% apply rate imply blended programmatic CPC ~$0.60-0.85 -- consistent with sponsored-board CPCs sitting above programmatic.

metadata.model: CPC/pay-per-view auction (Promoted Jobs); Job Slots are a separate flat-rate enterprise product
metadata.notes: LinkedIn's own FAQs confirm the auction model but publish no figure ('CPC fluctuates per day...cannot be determined until the job is posted'). $1.50-$4.50 band per Pin.com (aggregator-inferred); per-role examples: nursing $1.45, software eng $2.71, truck driving $4.45. Free tier: 1 active listing/14-day visibility. Prior April seed's 2.00-8.00 was LLM-generated and drifts high vs best available 2026 estimate.

metadata.model: Flat monthly subscription per job slot (Standard/Premium/Pro); custom quotes only, no public rate card; TrafficBoost add-on
metadata.notes: MODEL CHANGE vs April seed: ZipRecruiter does not sell CPC/CPA in 2026 -- subscription-per-slot with sales quotes (plans page shows no public pricing). Aggregator-estimated bands: Standard $299-399/mo, Premium $375-519/mo, Pro $719-999/mo per slot; TrafficBoost ~$299-500/boost. April's CPC 0.50-5.50/CPA 12-45 retired as a model-level contradiction; intentionally no cpc_range so this channel no longer feeds the live job-board CPC average.

metadata.model: No standalone job-ad product -- job visibility on Glassdoor is delivered by sponsoring on Indeed (Recruit Holdings integration)
metadata.notes: MODEL CHANGE vs April seed: since the Sept-2025 Indeed/Glassdoor consolidation (account-merge deadline Apr 20 2026; organic single-source-feed visibility on Indeed ended Mar 31 2026 unless sponsored), Glassdoor job ads run on Indeed's CPC engine -- plan Glassdoor via the Indeed entry. Glassdoor's own help article returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch; reconstructed from Job Board Doctor coverage + Glassdoor's 'Post Jobs | Glassdoor & Indeed' page. The separate 'Glassdoor Recruiting' employer-branding product is profile/brand visibility, not per-click job ads. April's standalone CPC 1-6/CPA 15-50 retired.

metadata.model: Monster+ credit-based: PAYG from $8/day (+$10 one-time setup) billed on candidate clicks/actions; Pro $299/mo (or $2,990/yr) incl. 299 credits, 1 credit=$1, resume view=2 credits
metadata.notes: VERIFIED from Monster's own live pricing page 2026-07-16 (all figures Monster-stated). No published per-click dollar range -- credit-based, so no cpc_range rather than an inferred one. April's CPC 0.30-4.00/CPA 10-40 unverifiable against current disclosure; retired.
